description: B2: on the causeway into Kingsfall - Thornwick's folk's warning of what the Ogre King wears and why it matters; once, never after his fall.
text: Thornwick's folk warned you: the Ogre King wears what he took from the Valley - its bell over his gut, shields for a crown, cart wheels, a keg on his back. Wood and iron splinter: lock on and {target_next} picks the trophy you can reach.
